title: Absolutely not user friendly
body:
There isnt any tab/button for you to look at all your habits at a glance, and editing habits are a nightmare - you have to tap in multiple times before you get the option to edit, and even then, the edit options are nestled even further in. 

A few changes to the dash to make this more user friendly would go a long way.

title: Great app but very buggy
body:
Downloaded the app and it was very impressed by the flexibility it offered. 
My only peeve ( and it is big enough to make me delete this app ) is that once you’ve closed the app ( which is very common for working people who need to do things like use WhatsApp and surf the net ) and come back to it, sometimes the timer/counter is still on. Sometimes, it just resets all the way back to 0. It can be really frustrating especially if you have set it to track something long like “Read for 120mins” and after 90 mins you had a call and after the conference call you come back and found that the counter is no longer running and now you’ve only read 0 minutes. 
Pls fix this bug and I’m sure it’ll be a wonderful app.
